footer.tagline: Professional car detailing services that restore and protect your vehicle's appearance with premium care and attention to detail.

services.subtitle: Choose your core cleaning package, then add the protection that fits your goals and budget.

basicWash.title: Basic Wash
basicWash.description: Quick and efficient refresh for both exterior and interior.
features: Contactless pre-wash & safe contact hand wash
Wheels & tires cleaned and dressed
Streak-free exterior glass cleaning
Quick surface wipe-down & floor vacuum
No tar/sap removal and no clay bar decontamination
No deep cleaning of fabric seats with extraction machine
No specialized carpet cleaning for stubborn dirt

fullDetail.title: Full Exterior & Interior Detail
fullDetail.description: Comprehensive inside-and-out detail that restores your car’s appearance.
features: Contactless pre-wash & hand wash using safe techniques
Clay bar decontamination + tar/sap removal
Wheel & tire deep clean and application of professional tire dressing
Crystal-clear glass cleaning (inside & out)
Full vacuuming and specialized carpet cleaning for stubborn dirt
Cleaning of air vents, plastics & trims with UV protection
Thorough cleaning of door jambs and trunk crevices
Leather cleaning & conditioning
Deep cleaning of fabric seats with extraction machine (wet-vac)

paintCorrection.title: Paint Correction
paintCorrection.description: Multi-stage machine polishing to remove swirls/oxidation and restore depth & clarity. Ideal prep before long-term coatings.
features: Contactless pre-wash and safe contact hand wash
Full decontamination: clay bar + removal of tar/sap deposits
Multi-stage machine polishing tailored to paint condition
Improves gloss, clarity, and color depth
Panel wipe to prepare the surface for protection
Recommended: add nano sealant or ceramic coating to lock in the finish

addons.title: Protection Options
addons.subtitle: Upgrade longevity, gloss, and hydrophobic performance with wax, nano sealant, or ceramic coating.

sprayWax.title: Spray Wax Protection
features: Polymer wax application for instant gloss
Basic hydrophobic effect
Reduces water spots and makes drying quicker
Durability: 4–6 weeks
Reapply: every wash or monthly

premiumWax.title: Premium Wax Protection
features: Natural carnauba wax blended with polymers for a deep, warm shine
Enhanced hydrophobic effect
Great for dark/metallic colors
Durability: 2–3 months
Reapply: every 2–3 months

ceramicSpray.title: Ceramic Spray Protection (SiO₂)
features: SiO₂ ceramic spray coating
Slick, smooth finish with enhanced gloss
Advanced hydrophobic effect
Durability: 3–4 months
Reapply: quarterly

nanoSealant.title: Nano Sealant Protection
features: Polymer nano sealant that chemically bonds to paint
Deep gloss, UV/chemical resistance, easier washing
High hydrophobic effect
Durability: up to 12 months
Reapply: annually
Recommended: paint correction before application for best bonding and finish

proCeramic.title: Professional Ceramic Coating (SiO₂)
features: High-end SiO₂ ceramic with a semi-permanent protective layer
Unmatched gloss and extreme hydrophobic performance
Strong resistance to UV, chemicals, tar and sap
Durability: 2+ years with proper maintenance
Reapply: every 24–30 months
Strongly advised: full paint correction before application to ensure flawless bonding and appearance

engineBay.title: Engine Bay Cleaning
features: Safe cleaning of engine bay with specialized products
Removes dust, oil, and grease buildup
Restores cleanliness and presentation of engine compartment
Reduces risk of corrosion and wear
Ideal before selling or showcasing the vehicle

pickupDropoff.title: Pick-up & Drop-off
features: We collect your car from your address
Detailing done at our location
Delivered back fresh & protected
